recent_history: 2026-10-12 session: Build Mode Floor 2/3 click-blocking bug (owner-reported, long live investigation) fully fixed and owner-confirmed ('Level 1 and 2 both work as meant to now'). Real root cause: Mouse.Target/ClickDetector hit-testing respects CanCollide, not CanQuery -- every earlier fix in this file's history that toggled CanQuery (gate, Access structure, Structures/Deck/Signs, per-floor isolation) was addressing the wrong property and never actually fixed anything, confirmed via two independent live debug probes (Raycast and Mouse.Target) that both hit a part already CanQuery=false. Real fix: all 222 unbuilt DimCellPlate instances world-wide set CanCollide=false permanently (safe, thin marker geometry); BuildController's per-floor isolation (updateFloorQueryState) extended to toggle CanCollide on built CombCell geometry per non-selected floor, guarded against disabling collision on whichever floor the player is physically standing on. Added a floor-selector UI (FloorTabRow / Floor1Tab/Floor2Tab/Floor3Tab in BuildGui) per owner's explicit choice so Build Mode only targets one floor's cells at a time, plus a visual transparency fade on non-selected floors' Access (ramp/stair) structures. Deliberately NOT yet touched: CanCollide on Access/ramp geometry itself (real walkable stairs, real fall-through risk) -- only revisit if owner reports a specific remaining blocker there. Full detail in buglist.md #106. Next: owner asked for a GitHub backup of all games worked on, then flagged the ladybug meshes need redoing (not happy with current look).
